title: Laddu, Chintu and the Smudgy Shape Rangoli
moral: Telling the truth, even when it is hard, makes things better.
description: Pinky has made a beautiful shape rangoli for the Masti Nagar Rangoli Contest, until Laddu and Chintu's cricket ball goes BOING right into it! Will they blame Golu the goat, or tell the truth? Learn circles, squares, triangles, stars and hearts with Laddu, Chintu, Pinky, Dadaji and Golu in this funny animated story about honesty for kids aged 3 to 8.
outro: The End! Remember, friends: telling the truth, even when it is hard, makes things better. And Laddu? He is STILL dreaming of a jalebi rangoli! See you tomorrow... bye-bye!

narration.text: Good morning, Masti Nagar! Today is the big Rangoli Contest!
Pinky made a super-duper rangoli with bright coloured powder. Wah!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Look! A circle, a square, a triangle, a star and a heart! Leave it to Pinky!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Ooh! That orange circle looks just like a giant jalebi!
Grumble, rumble! Laddu's tummy agreed.

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: I'm off to get more colours. Please be careful, boys!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Careful is my middle name!

narration.text: Then Laddu and Chintu played cricket in the lane, right next to Pinky's house.

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! My super-spinny ball! Whirrrr!
Laddu swung his bat. WHOOSH! Missed!
He swung again. WHOOSH! Missed again, and he spun round like a top! Wibble, wobble!
The third time... WHACK! The ball flew up, up, up... BOING!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Uh-oh. Where did it land?
Can you guess? Right in the middle of Pinky's rangoli!

narration.text: SPLAT! The star went smudgy, the heart went squishy, and colours flew everywhere!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Ah... ah... ACHOO! Now my nose is PINK!
Jingle, jingle! In trotted Golu the goat, munching a marigold.

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Psst, Laddu! We could say... Golu did it!
Golu blinked his big, innocent eyes. Blink, blink!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: No, Chintu. Golu didn't do it. We did. We must tell the truth.

narration.text: WHEEEET! Pinky's super-loud whistle! She was back!
Chintu got such a fright, his glasses jumped right off his nose. Plop!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: My rangoli! Who did this?
Laddu's knees went wibbly. But he stepped forward.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: We did, Pinky. Our cricket ball smudged it. We are very sorry.

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: It's true. It was us. And we will help you fix it!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Thank you for telling the truth! Chalo, let's make it even better!

narration.text: They ran to the market for new colours. And look! Shapes everywhere!
The laddoos are round, round, round. That's a CIRCLE!
The barfi has four sides, all the same. That's a SQUARE!
And what shape is the samosa? Can you tell?

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: I know! A samosa is shaped like a... YUMMY!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Ha ha! No, Laddu! A samosa is a TRIANGLE! It has three sides!
Golu sniffed the pink powder... ACHOO!
Now he was a pink goat! Ba-a-a-a!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! I'll draw the circle with a stick. Round and round and round!
Round and round went Chintu... until he got dizzy and BONK! Down he sat!
So Laddu curled up and ROLLED like a ball. Roly-poly! A perfect round circle!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Now the square! How many sides does a square have? Count with me!
One, two, three, four! A square has FOUR sides!

popups.sub: a red heart, full of love

narration.text: At sunset, Dadaji came to see. He sat down... and dozed off. SNOOORE!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake! Now... where are my glasses?
They were on his head! Ho ho HO!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Dadaji, look at our STAR! Let's count its points!
One, two, three, four, five! A star has FIVE points!
And last of all, a big red HEART.
Golu took one big sniff... and tried to eat the heart! Ba-a-a-a!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! Golu, hearts are for loving, not for munching!

narration.text: That night, little lamps twinkled all around the rangoli. Let's remember!
Which shape has three sides?
A triangle! Just like a samosa!
And which shape is round, like a laddoo?
A circle! You're so clever!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: And thank you, boys, for telling me the truth.

narration.text: At the Rangoli Contest, everyone clapped. First prize for Pinky and her helpers! Hooray!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Telling the truth was hard. But it made everything better!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: And so did my roly-poly circle!
Uh-oh... munch, munch! Golu was eating the prize ribbon!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Arre wah! Next year, can we draw a JALEBI shape?
